posts.cooked: I am repeating SC OPPE this term and as the BPT’s are already submitted and I have also rechecked before deadline but my scores are showing Absent while I passed all four the last term.

posts.name: Ankit
posts.cooked:
Have you resubmitted those BPTs this term?

If not, that’s why it’s showing as absent. To be eligible for OPPE, you need to resubmit those solutions again this term.
